== frame stderr_duplicated_first cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' 2>&1 > first.txt | cat
|err
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat first.txt
|out
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame stdout_redirected_first cursor=12,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' 2>&1 > first.txt | cat
|err
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat first.txt
|out
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' > second.txt 2>&1 | cat
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat second.txt
|out
|err
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@12 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame substitution_captures_stderr cursor=15,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' 2>&1 > first.txt | cat
|err
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat first.txt
|out
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' > second.txt 2>&1 | cat
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cat second.txt
|out
|err
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo [$(sh -c 'echo out; echo err >&2' 2>&1)]
|[out err]
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 sh
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cat
@12 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@12 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@15 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
